reviews.title: Main menu + Shop (Upgrades)
reviews.verdict: Strong synthwave mood, but the menu is four different button systems and the shop sells things I can't afford without telling me.
reviews.consumer_take: The first second works: pink neon title, perspective grid, it looks like a game. Then I look at the buttons and nothing lines up. START is wide, Daily reward is narrow, the grid below is wider than both, and its two columns almost touch. STORY is the same yellow as the free-coins button, so I'm not sure if it's a mode or an ad. There's a DEV button in the corner. In the shop I have 50 coins and every upgrade costs 375 or more, yet every price looks the same as if I could tap it. Half the screen under BACK is empty while the list I came for is cut off. I'd keep playing, but I'd stop trusting the menus.
strengths: Strong, consistent theme: neon palette and grid floor read as one style on both screens.
Shop cards are consistent: 548/549px wide, 24px gutter, equal row pitch.
Grid edge margins are equal (59px left and right) and every menu button is centered on the screen (cx 594.5).
reviews.coverage: Audited: main menu, shop Upgrades tab, one phone size, English. Not audited: Ships and Store tabs, gameplay HUD, pause, other sizes, Arabic/Hebrew.

findings.finding: Four button widths (861 / 599 / 1071 / 605) and five heights (133 / 132 / 106 / 117 / 114); left edge jumps 164 → 59
findings.title: Four button widths, two column edges: 861 / 599 / 1071 / 605 px

options.text: One column width for everything: all buttons 1071 wide, aligned with the grid
Two tiers: START/STORY 861, grid shrunk to 861 total (2 × 419 + 23 gap), Daily reward and QUIT 599
Rebuild the menu on one 8px spacing scale with height tokens 132 / 112

findings.pick_reason: it keeps START dominant and gives the whole menu one left and right edge

findings.finding: Balance 50, cheapest price 375, every price drawn the same `#89899B`
findings.title: Balance 50, every price from 375 to 1500 looks buyable

options.text: Price in red `#FF5A6E` when balance < price, and dim the card to 60%
(a) plus a "Need 325 more" line and a "Watch ad +100" shortcut on unaffordable cards
Add a real Buy button per card with normal / disabled / maxed states

findings.pick_reason: it fixes the state and turns a dead end into the existing rewarded-ad offer

findings.finding: 315px dead space under BACK and 153px above SHOP while the list is cut mid-card
findings.title: 315px dead space under BACK, list cut off mid-card

options.text: Move BACK to the top-left as a back arrow and let the list run to the ad
Keep BACK at the bottom but dock it 16px above the ad and extend the viewport
Also shrink the top area: SHOP title into the top bar line

findings.pick_reason: it gives the list the most room and matches where players look for back

findings.finding: STORY uses the reward yellow of Daily reward and +100
findings.title: STORY uses the reward yellow

options.text: STORY in the cyan secondary style, keep yellow for rewards only
STORY as a second pink in outline style

findings.pick_reason: one color = one meaning: yellow means free coins

findings.finding: Grid column gap 7px vs row gap 23px
findings.title: Grid column gap 7px vs row gap 23px

options.text: Column gap 23px (buttons 524 wide)
Both gaps 16px

findings.pick_reason: it matches the existing row rhythm and the main stack gap (29px) better

findings.title: DEV button visible, 2.93:1

options.text: Hide it in release builds behind a build flag
Remove it and open dev tools with a 5-tap on the title

findings.finding: Margins 23px left vs 45px right; content 11px left of center
findings.title: Margins 23px left, 45px right

Keep the scrollbar outside and set left = right = 45px

findings.title: Level pips 1.42:1, invisible

Replace pips with "Lv 0/3" text

findings.finding: Grid lines and the horizon line run through MISSIONS / HOW TO PLAY
findings.title: Background lines run through labels

options.text: Grid buttons 85% opaque fill `#0F3F4C`

findings.finding: "DIFFICULTY: NORMAL" text is 17px tall with no control look
findings.title: Difficulty text 17px tall, no affordance

options.text: If it's tappable: make it a pill button "Normal ▾" ≥ 112px tall

options.text: "STORE" and rename it "COIN PACKS" so it isn't a store inside the shop
"STORE" only

findings.finding: QUIT (605×114) sits in the thumb zone; Android back already exits
findings.title: QUIT takes the thumb zone

options.text: Remove QUIT, keep Android back to exit with a confirm dialog
Move it into Settings
